name: OFAC SDN
note: Updated automatically by sync (US Treasury OFAC SDN list; covers BTC, ETH, TRON, USDT addresses). If the link ever changes, download SDN.XML by hand from sanctionslist.ofac.treas.gov and save it as sdn.xml.

name: Codatta sample
note: Dataset page: huggingface.co/datasets/Codatta/Crypto-Address-Annotation-10K (10k-row sample). Save as CSV. Check the license terms before commercial use.

name: My verified cases
note: Your own confirmed addresses. Columns: address,name,category (and optional chain).

name: evm-labels (Etherscan-derived)
note: github.com/dawsbot/evm-labels (MIT code, ~170k EVM labels). The data was collected from Etherscan, whose terms limit reuse: fine for your own investigation, check the terms before using it in a paid product. Export the data to CSV with columns address,nameTag,label.
